form:FormGroup.label: On
form:FormGroup.helpText: The outcome this fires on. A transition on an outcome fires at once, on the first candidate that has it; 'spent' fires when the step's candidates are gone.

form:FormGroup.label: Go to
form:FormGroup.helpText: The step to go to. 'end' completes the flow and binds what was learned; 'park' parks the session for a person; 'give-up' gives the learner up and errors its streams; 'abandon' takes the step's own default: give-up for a parser, park for any other step.
